source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When activation has not arrived, the new helper timer calls win.focus and resolves immediately. Promise.race can therefore finish through that timer without observing activate; clearing the timer and yielding a tick is not a final active-window assertion. Its Assert.report calls only print diagnostics. The flowed-reply caller still awaits its own promiseFocus afterward and keeps the source message window open until draft inspection ends. This is a completion boundary, not a reproduced focus failure.
title: The file-message focus fallback resolves after requesting focus
